description: This file defines data structures and functions for handling properties within a board model, including property schemas, property definitions, property value resolution, and parsing logic for properties and schemas in a project related to Mattermost's Focalboard.

classes.name: PropValueResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving user IDs to user objects, used for decoding property values.

classes.name: BlockProperties
classes.description: Type alias for a map of BlockProp objects keyed by property ID.

classes.name: BlockProp
classes.description: Represents a property attached to a block, including its ID, index, name, and value.

classes.name: PropSchema
classes.description: Type alias for a map of PropDef objects keyed by property ID.

classes.name: PropDefOption
classes.description: Defines an option within a property definition, including ID, index, color, and value.

classes.name: PropDef
classes.description: Defines a property schema, including ID, name, type, and options.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Resolves the display value of a property based on its type and raw value, optionally resolving user IDs to usernames.

methods.name: ParseDate
methods.description: Parses a JSON string representing a date range into a human-readable date format.

methods.name: ParsePropertySchema
methods.description: Extracts property schema definitions from a board's fields.

methods.name: getMapString
methods.description: Helper function to safely extract a string value from a map by key.

methods.name: ParseProperties
methods.description: Parses a block's fields to extract property values, resolving references if a resolver is provided.
